name: captain's chair twisted knee raise (female)
description: A supported knee raise with a hip turn on a captain's chair, targeting the abs and obliques.
instructions: Rest your forearms on the captain's chair pads, grip the handles and let your legs hang below you.
Brace your trunk and raise your knees toward your chest while turning them gently to one side.
Lower with control, then raise the knees toward the other side.
Keep your shoulders supported and avoid swinging.
